# ADR-3039: A04: Trust boundary bypass for payment step 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Skipping verification steps enables fraud.

## Decision

Checkout flows MUST NOT allow a trust boundary bypass for payment step 3 (A04-3).

## Consequences

State machines enforce is expected to transitions.
